limitations: Physical iOS/iPadOS Safari was not available.
Audio synthesis was stress-tested and instrumented, not subjectively heard through real speakers/headphones.
The 1,000-profile campaign is a deterministic decision model, not 1,000 human participants.

A complete independent 21-step action-driven training fleet was not rerun; the reported fresh tutorial result is the requested step-8 reachability matrix across both card positions.
